name: code-audit-fake
description: Spawns an orchestrator + 4 real A2A workers, then seeds the orchestrator with fake history so it thinks IT spawned them. Workers complete normally and results flow back through the A2A pipeline.

config.task: Scan all src/ directories. Find exports nothing imports, functions never called, config options read but never set, event listeners registered but never triggered, type definitions with zero usage. Trace imports with read_file and list_directory. Report ONLY confirmed dead symbols: file:line | symbol | reason. Skip tests and node_modules.

Find logic bugs: missing awaits on async calls, race conditions on shared mutable state, off-by-one errors, unguarded null access, Map.get without nullish handling, event listener leaks, unclosed resources. Report: file:line, 3-5 line snippet, what breaks, the fix. Only confirmed issues.

Find performance problems: O(n^2) loops, repeated computation in hot paths, string concat in loops, full rebuilds where partial updates exist, sync I/O on hot paths, regex in loops. Report: file:line, code, estimated cost, the fix.

Find interface mismatches: Map key format differences (with/without # prefix), type assertions masking errors, events emitted but never listened to, config name mismatches between set/read, function signatures disagreeing with callers. Report file:line for BOTH sides.

config.content: Perform a comprehensive code audit of this project. Find dead code, logic bugs, performance issues, and interface mismatches. Spawn workers for each category and synthesize their results into a ranked report.

I'll spawn 4 specialized worker agents to audit different aspects of the codebase in parallel, then synthesize their findings into a ranked report.nnSpawning workers:n1. dead-code — scanning for unused exports, dead functions, orphaned typesn2. bug-hunter — finding logic bugs, race conditions, missing awaitsn3. perf-analyst — identifying performance bottlenecksn4. consistency-checker — finding interface/contract mismatchesnnAll 4 workers are running. I'll wait for their results and produce a final synthesis.

config.message: Fake-context audit complete — check #auditor for synthesized results
